infer_pdb_single_sequence: infer a protein structure from a single amino acid sequence and return the PDB file string
infer_pdbs_batch_sequences: infer protein structures from a list of amino acid sequences and return a list of PDB file strings
infer_sequences_raw_output: infer protein structures from sequences and return the raw model output dictionary with plddt and coordinates
forward_tensor_pass: run a forward pass on amino acid token tensors with optional masking patterns and recycle iterations
set_chunk_size_memory: set the axial attention chunk size to reduce memory usage from O(L^2) to approximately O(L)
